What do you think of Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not surprising...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, you could help me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What makes you think I'll help you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're nice, and I need it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fair enough. What is it?
Spencer has failed...

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You came in here angrier than normal... It's like you went straight from 'I'm going to punch something' to 'I'm going to tear someone's head off'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's nothing... Just some problems I'm having with the football team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! You threw a punch at me last week!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That doesn't count! That's just a... Scuffle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not a fight unless both people land at least one punch.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then no, I've never been in a fight.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've just been in a lot of 'scuffles'. And all of them with you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That wasn't the best question...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not really what science is about.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You've done `something,` though, haven't you? I can see it in your nerdy eyes. Don't make me twist your arm...
nodes.text_bbcode: You've done [color=#e23b3b][i]something,[/i][/color] though, haven't you? I can see it in your nerdy eyes. Don't make me twist your arm...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you know that's not just an expression with me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Son of a... It `did` happen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Son of a... It [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] happen!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay. I'll tell you... But you can't tell any of my friends about this...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't even know you had friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One time, I was doing this experiment where you can make fire dance by running sound vibrations and propane through a tube.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, it's pretty awesome... Only I forgot to account for overheating in the tube.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what happened?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I played some heavy metal music and blew a hole through my garage door.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! That rocks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was not the perspective my dad had...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It does bother my mom a lot, me getting into all this trouble.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad doesn't even notice when I get into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you don't get into trouble, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, I break the rules!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Going to the restroom without a hall pass doesn't count!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on, have you ever actually...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fun? Fun?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it fun terrifying people? Or stealing from them?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you have fun all those times that you `punched me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you have fun all those times that you [color=#e23b3b][i]punched me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay... So maybe 'fun' isn't the right word...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, why don't you think about it some more...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've always been this way...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My dad's a military guy. Before he left, he taught me how to fight. How to take care of myself.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But 'nice' was never really part of his program.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not going to pry... But that does explain things a bit.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's not all that's bothering you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You told me about your parents, dummy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, yeah. I forgot.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My mom always says that when you've got a lot going on in your head, you start knocking other stuff out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I figure you're probably `very` forgetful.
nodes.text_bbcode: I figure you're probably [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] forgetful.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh... I was just thinking that I've been trying to achieve this pre-ordered life...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Excel in science. Go to a prestigious college. Meet a compatible girl. Follow in my father's footsteps.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But those footsteps lead to divorce!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now that I've found Denni, I just don't want to mess things up with her the way my dad did with my mom...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be so lame, Kale. She'll see you're the right guy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... You're being unusually nice.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Am I?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, normally you're a lot meaner.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is that? I mean, why are you `ever` mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why is that? I mean, why are you [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] mean?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know... Being mean is...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And how exactly am I supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Copy him! What does he do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He rides a motorcycle, he treats people like dirt, and he's always scheming.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There you go.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's your advice? That's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's working for him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't have a motorcycle! I'm nice! And I'm not a schemer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Exactly... And it's `not` working for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly... And it's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] working for you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I see why you don't have a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, the only reason I don't have a girlfriend is because girls are too afraid of me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yet this didn't stop you from volunteering advice?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And how exactly am I supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, I don't know a lot about girls...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I know this Colt guy's a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: At some point, he's going to hurt her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, that's probably true.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All you gotta do is be patient, Kale. It's just like fighting...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: When he messes up, you strike!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That is... Surprisingly sound advice.
Bryce comes running over...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He deserved it!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You mean, he deserved to be tackled after the play?! He's on your team! Apologize! Now!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Fine, you're off the team!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? But how are we going to beat Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Without you! Good teams don't tolerate infighting!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine! Whatever! I've got detention anyway!
Spencer storms off. Bryce calls to him...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You've got talent, Spencer... I can tell. Too bad it's wasted by that temper of yours!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Looks like I blew that one...
When Spencer steps into the detention room, all the seats are taken, except for the one right next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer! Welcome back! I knew you'd want to sit next to your best friend, Ben, so I saved the seat next to him!
Spencer reluctantly sits in the seat next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why does everyone keep saying we're best friends?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I tried to tell her...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I have an emergency nurse task to perform! I'm not supposed to leave you troublemakers alone, but none of you seem like troublemakers so...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm off! Behave! Not that I really need to warn you!
Ms. Lee leaves...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is she serious about us not causing trouble? Cause I got put in here for tying a bunch of nerds together and rolling them down a hill.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Heh. Nerd-ball.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I knocked a model glacier over and then she found me guilty for 'playing with snow'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's crazy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She'd have to be if she thinks `you're` an upstanding citizen.
nodes.text_bbcode: She'd have to be if she thinks [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] an upstanding citizen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh.
Ben's phone rings! He answers...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni. I can't really talk. I'm in detention. We're not supposed to use our phones.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt did what?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, what do you want me to say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. Bye.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Girl problems, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Something like that. Denni's completely fixated on Colt!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's an easy one. I know exactly what you should do...
Spencer leaps into the air... But Jacob ducks! Spencer lands hard on the other side of him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Oooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Heh! Next time you go after me, try to move faster than an elephant!
Jacob crouches down to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And just so you know, tackling your own teammate isn't tough either...
Spencer keeps his center of gravity low and tackles Jacob, wrapping him up by the legs! Jacob falls!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `Oooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm tough!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah... Tough enough to attack your own teammate!
Spencer hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm just going to leap at him like I'm attacking a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: What were you doing out there?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Tackling?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Howard, I thought you said this guy had talent!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He does!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: So you saw him tackle somebody?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I heard from someone that he tackled a guy... In a hallway...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: And that's the guy who's supposed to replace Phil?! Some hallway tackler?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Give him a chance...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Amanda leap!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Amanda leap![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Amanda leaps onto Spencer's back holding him around the neck!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Amanda! Let go!
He flails about, trying to get Amanda off his back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let go!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Weeeee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Weeeee![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He spins around again and again, but Amanda hangs on!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` ponies!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] ponies!

nodes.text: Spencer crumples to his knees, exhausted...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Too... Tired...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! Keep going, pony!
Spencer collapses to the ground. The last thing he sees before he passes out is Amanda standing over him...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Bad pony! No carrot!
After school, Spencer approaches the football field...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, Spencer, how hard can this be? Just get out there and tackle... No big deal.
Spencer takes a deep breath and steps onto the field...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are. I told you he'd come!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever. There's still no way he'll be as good as Phil!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah!
Howard pulls Spencer aside...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're not exactly well-liked around here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nothing new.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Coach is out today... So you're going to be working with some of the assistant coaches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: These guys are college-level players. They're filling in for Coach when they could be spending time `at college,` and they know why you're here.
nodes.text_bbcode: These guys are college-level players. They're filling in for Coach when they could be spending time [color=#e23b3b][i]at college,[/i][/color] and they know why you're here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah...
Two older-looking guys approach...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I'm Bryce. We're pretty upset about what you did to Phil. Howard here said you might have some talent, so our plan is to work you into the ground.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: We know you're never going to be as good as Phil, but we're out of options, so we're going to try you out in a scrimmage first.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You'd better have what it takes!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Any questions?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. A scrimmage is...?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Just shut up, tackle the guy with the ball, and try not to hurt any more players!
Jacob slams into Spencer, but Spencer manages to hold his ground!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! You've lost! I can't be taken down, and you've got an entire mob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So far, you're right... But I was just a distraction...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh?
Spencer freezes! Jacob slams into him, knocking him backward against a locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ooooooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooooooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer falls! The last thing he sees before he blacks out is Jacob, peering down at him and grinning...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Night night.
Spencer flings Jessica off him and gets back on his feet...
Just in time to see Jacob hurtling toward him!
Spencer hesitates! Howard's elbow connects with his stomach!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ooooooooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooooooooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer doubles over. In his moment of weakness, the mob piles on top of him, attacking him relentlessly...
Clearly...
Spencer rolls away just before Howard comes crashing down!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Phew!
But before Spencer can get back to his feet, Jessica pounces on him, scratching at him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We loved Phil!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ow! Quit it!
Spencer dodges out of the way, but Sam hits him with her backpack, sending him to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We! Hate! `You!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We! Hate! [color=#3b78e2][i]You![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Zach's punch connects! Spencer stands there for a moment, dizzy, then collapses to the floor!
The last thing he hears before he blacks out is...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Weakling...
Spencer takes off his backpack and cracks his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's do this...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Get him!
The mob swarms Spencer!
Zach reaches Spencer first, throwing a punch at his face!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guess I don't have a choice. Besides... I'll take any chance to beat up more of those Wilson dummies.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait! What's keeping him from just not showing up to practice?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! We want blood!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: If he doesn't show up, he'll have to deal with the whole football team coming after him! And we're a little tougher than the nerds he's used to picking on!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then it's settled. See you on the field after school!
The mob disperses... Spencer pulls Howard aside.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I want to beat Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You do? Cause it doesn't seem like it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! Keep it down, will you?! I don't want anyone to know that I actually, you know...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Care?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't tell anyone, or I'll punch you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I won't... Your secret's safe.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Don't do it again!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?! 'Don't do it again'? That's it? Shouldn't Spencer be in more trouble?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Such a funny face! You look like a grumpy baby when you're angry!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hrmph! Just help Phil...
Ms. Lee inspects Phil's ankle. After a few moments, she hangs her head.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I'm afraid it's about as bad as it gets... His ankle is severely sprained!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But the Homecoming Game!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm afraid not.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unless we perform an ankle transplant... But I think I'm underqualified.
A rumbling comes from the other side of the door...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's that noise?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think it's coming from the hall!
Jacob opens the door, revealing...
A mob of students gathered in the hall!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is Phil okay?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: His ankle's sprained... He isn't going to be able to play!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And it's all Spencer's fault!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's Erik's fault!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jacob's right! I saw the whole thing! If Spencer hadn't been such a bully, we would still have a chance against Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If we don't win the game, no one will care about Homecoming Queen! It'll be like Prom all over again!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Spencer just cost us the game!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did we play it already? Who won Homecoming Queen?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This morning Spencer was awesome! Now I hate him! I don't know what to feel!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Kill Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah! Kill him!
The mob closes in on Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Wait!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wait![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh no! This is where bleeding-heart Howard makes his big speech about how Spencer here doesn't deserve to be pummeled!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't need anyone's help!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually... I was all for pummeling you too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But then I remembered something Ben told me... He said that when you two pranked Wilson, you tackled Alexei!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa! Alexei's impossible to tackle!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's not `that` impressive! Alexei probably wasn't even looking!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] impressive! Alexei probably wasn't even looking!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it was `Ben` who told me! You can trust Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: But it was [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben[/i][/color] who told me! You can trust Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You mean Ben, Spencer's new `best friend!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean Ben, Spencer's new [color=#e23b3b][i]best friend![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? You don't know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who cares? None of this heals Phil, does it?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... It doesn't heal Phil. But instead of mobbing Spencer, why don't we just make him take Phil's place?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! What?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think about it! Spencer's always beating people up, he's tough, and he apparently has tackling skills... He also hates Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I don't `play` football!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]play[/i][/color] football!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: He doesn't even want to play. Come on, let's get him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hold on... Let's let `him` decide!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold on... Let's let [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] decide!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's it gonna be, Spencer? You can fight us, or you can pay for your crime and try out for football...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know about that, Spencer. You did kinda push me into him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you flailed!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't blame this on Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait! He's right, Jacob. I'm just as guilty... I did flail my arms a lot...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Erik! How could you?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know! I've always been a flailer.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: All he did was turn the corner!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He shouldn't have been there!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer! I thought you knew better!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Never blame a star athlete for anything! They can't be touched!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like I care about the stupid school's athletes...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: `Owww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owww![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who cares about the game? Who cares about Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And who cares about Phil's stupid ankle? He'll heal!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's cold, man! Even for you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well, whatever.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It seems like all you care about is some game...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Meanwhile, your friend is in a lot of pain. If he even is your friend...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're... You're...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're right... Sorry, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's okay! Can we just...?
But a wall of cheerleaders forms in front of him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More girls! More drama!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We know you've got school spirit after what you did for us, Spencer! That's why we know you'll vote for `Taylor` for Homecoming Queen! Hit it, girls!
nodes.text_bbcode: We know you've got school spirit after what you did for us, Spencer! That's why we know you'll vote for [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor[/i][/color] for Homecoming Queen! Hit it, girls!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders do a quick dance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: { T.A.Y.L.O.R! {

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: { T! T is for terrific! {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { A! A is for Amanda! {

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! Cut! Amanda! How many times do we have to practice this?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But my name starts with A!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're spelling `my` name!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're spelling [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] name!

nodes.text: Spencer slips past them while they're distracted...
...And Sam cuts him off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you going to give me a treat or do some lame cheer? Because right now I would rather be snoring in class than dealing with any of this Homecoming Queen crap.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, I was going to tell you that you're a fake! I don't buy for one second that you have any team spirit at all! I know what you're about!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! This girl's really angry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're just like Colt! Endearing people to you but really causing nothing but trouble!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She must be comparing me to the guy she used to date!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get out of my way...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just vote for Sam if you like honesty, you jerk!
Sam storms off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She totally likes me.
Just then Erik applies a sticker to Spencer's shirt...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! What is that?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It says, 'Vote for Sara! She's the Queen of the Sea!'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Campaigning! Sara's busy training, so I volunteered to champion for her cause! Heh! I'm championing a champion!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, you four-eyed geek! I mean, how come you're not afraid of me?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, you're reformed... Er... Aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! And now I'm going to re-form you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer shoves Erik, who goes flying wildly backwards! At that moment, Phil and Jacob come from around the corner...
And Erik slams into Phil! Phil falls, his ankle twisting at an awkward angle!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: `Ahhh! My ankle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh! My ankle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `My spleen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]My spleen![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Phil tries to stand but crumples back down to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Is it bad?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think it's ruptured!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're fine! I'm talking to Phil!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: `It hurts, man!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It hurts, man![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob glares at Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Phil's our best defensive player! The Homecoming Game against Wilson is `next week!` You'd better hope his ankle's okay!
nodes.text_bbcode: Phil's our best defensive player! The Homecoming Game against Wilson is [color=#e23b3b][i]next week![/i][/color] You'd better hope his ankle's okay!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `I'm` not what actually matters here...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] not what actually matters here...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, please, enlighten me! What actually matters?
Spencer shoves the cupcake into his mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa! Does this mean I have your vote?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No... I hate this popularity contest stuff! I'm not one of you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... The cupcake...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Was delicious! Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're welcome...
Spencer continues on, trying to walk past Taylor's table...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Would one of your popular friends do this?!
Spencer squishes the cupcake in his hand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was silly! Now you've got frosting and cake all over your hand! Why did you do that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't really think it through...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here! Let me clean it off for you! I'll go get some napkins!
As $ZOE looks for napkins, Spencer wipes his hand off on a passing nerd...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ew.
...And walks on, trying to get past Taylor's table...
Ben pulls Denni aside...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, I need to talk to you about us. You said that you just needed to figure things out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know I did, and I don't want to be one of those girls who just strings you along, but, um, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stringing me along?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh. In a totally friendly way... I need more time. Is that okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've gotta go... More pictures to take.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See ya.
Denni hurries off. Spencer walks up.
Denni takes the picture.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Can you put it in a different section?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like an `Ultra Friends` category? I don't know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Like an [color=#3b78e2][i]Ultra Friends[/i][/color] category? I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, like a 'Not Best Friends' category.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You guys aren't best friends?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, we're more like... Prank pals.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, yeah, sure... I'll find another place for it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sick of all this attention! All we did was prank a badger!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Denni... Today might not be a good day for this...

nodes.title: Big Shoes to Phil
nodes.subtitle: Does Spencer have what it takes?

nodes.text: One morning, Spencer's hanging out in front of the school when he sees Ben walk by...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! Kale! Come over here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think so... You've got your 'I'm going to punch something' face on.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to punch you, chicken. I just need to ask you a question...
Ben cautiously approaches.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Have people been acting weird around you? Since we pulled the prank, I mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... They will `not` stop bugging me about which Homecoming Princess I'm going to vote for! As though my opinion actually mattered!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... They will [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] stop bugging me about which Homecoming Princess I'm going to vote for! As though my opinion actually mattered!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ever since we pulled that prank, it's like our stock is through the roof!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't like it. It makes me feel like a stupid celebrity.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And everyone just assumes we're best friends!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! It's like no one even remembered when you were throwing me into trash cans.
Some of the popular students pass them...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, look who it is! The dynamic duo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh. Spenceman and Ro`ben!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Spenceman and Ro[color=#e23b3b][i]ben![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You guys are the best! What a team!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! It's Bencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Denni's coming over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We haven't really talked since I tried to kiss her!
Denni approaches with her camera...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, guys, can I get a picture of the two of you for the 'Best Friends' section of the yearbook?

nodes.prompt: This is ;sudden death overtime;, so the first team to score wins. Do whatever it takes to score!
In overtime, `the first team to score wins`, so don't let them get a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look! I believe in you guys! We can do this! We can stop them! Be strong!

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: What happened? Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm the middle linebacker!
The defensive unit gets back into position...
Zach drops back with the ball and throws a pass to Jacob in the end zone... But Chris intercepts it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! In your face, offense! Way to go... Uh... Chris!

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Good work out there, defense!
Spencer takes a step toward Jacob, but Bryce holds him back!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Enough!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Just like I thought! You haven't made any progress!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That kind of hot-headedness is going to be our downfall!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Meow meow meow!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nice job, man. I was just testing you! You're not Phil, but you've got skills...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Not enough skills!
Spencer takes a step toward Jacob, but Bryce holds him back!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Enough!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Just like I thought! You haven't made any progress!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That kind of hot-headedness is going to be our downfall!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I think it's pretty clear that Spencer here just doesn't have what it takes to be a part of this football team...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Told you...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Shut up, Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Unfortunately, the game is next week, and we don't have a better replacement... So he's the one we're going with...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What? That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What are you guys talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't understand why everyone's so impressed! He's still a coward who doesn't actually care about the team!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr!
Both defenders get past Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `Yaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As they race down the field, Spencer continues to block guys out of the way with crushing hits!
Jacob sprints by and into the endzone for the touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: That was awesome, dude!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I know you two don't like each other, but that was impressive teamwork! I'm glad you were able to rise above your differences.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks, Bryce.
As Spencer moves down the field, defenders keep piling up on Jacob! Eventually, he is pulled down!
Jacob yells at Spencer from the bottom of the pile!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You did that on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No I didn't!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Either you're lying and you're a jerk, or you can't block and you suck!
Bryce blows on a whistle...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: All right... I've seen enough!
Two defenders come at once, their bodies low to the ground!
Spencer swats him out of the air!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: `Oooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer misses him! Zach slams into Jacob... But Jacob manages to stay on his feet!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Do you think you could `actually` protect me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you think you could [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] protect me?!

nodes.text: Jacob keeps following Spencer!
Zach tries to leap over Spencer for the tackle!
Spencer misses him! Jacob spins out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're supposed to `block!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're supposed to [color=#e23b3b][i]block![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer smashes the defender!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You guys aren't even trying! We might as well give up! All of you suck anyway!

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: He `is` going to punch us!
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] going to punch us!

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chris suddenly runs off the field...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? I was just trying to motivate him.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nice going, jerk. You `motivated` another one of our players off the team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice going, jerk. You [color=#e23b3b][i]motivated[/i][/color] another one of our players off the team!

nodes.text: For the next few plays, Zach moves the offense downfield easily!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Come on, Spencer! Get in there! Attack the quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm trying!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: All you are is a coward and a traitor!
Spencer's temper boils over with rage! He charges at Jacob before the ball is even snapped!
Suddenly, Spencer is slammed from the side by Bryce and knocked completely off his feet!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Oooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Not again! I won't tolerate insubordination! This is your `last` warning!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not again! I won't tolerate insubordination! This is your [color=#e23b3b][i]last[/i][/color] warning!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Heh... That's what you get!
Bryce gets in Jacob's face!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You're not helping things either. Which means you're a part of the problem. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yes, Coach.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You haven't, have you? You can't do anything right! You completely ruined us when you hurt Phil! You probably did it on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Spencer's idea of fair is to beat up on ninety-pound nerds who couldn't throw a punch without having an asthma attack!
Jacob looks at Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Have you even won a fight against someone your own size?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Too bad he's never fought in a fair fight!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Watch out, guys! He could try to tackle any one of you when you're not looking!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrrr!
The next day, Spencer shows up for football practice...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm kind of surprised you came back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I got some advice from a friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, you mean Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Someone else! One of my other friends!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Ken... Kenjamin.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kenjamin?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, fine. `Ben.` You got a problem?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, fine. [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben.[/i][/color] You got a problem?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. That's cool.
Bryce eyes Spencer from across the field. He comes over...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm here for another shot!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Why should I give it to you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Because I'm not a quitter! Because Wilson deserves to experience me crushing them! And because I've changed my attitude!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: We're doing some set plays today, so you'll have plenty of opportunities to test your new attitude.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: All right, guys. First we're going to work on our blitzing and our blitz coverage.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Just try to tackle the guy with the ball!
Spencer and the rest of the defense get into position against the offensive unit...
As Zach calls out the play, Jacob glares at Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Surprised you showed your face around here, you dumb coward!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've got to control my temper... What did Ben say? Think of something soft and cute, like a...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: One more play everyone...
The players line up for one more play... Spencer stands poised on defense. He looks around and sees his fellow defenders bent over at the waist, out-of-breath, sweaty, and tired.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! What are you guys, a bunch of wusses? You can't show weakness!

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: Please don't kill us! We're on defense with you!
Zach hikes the ball, steps back, and throws a long pass to the end zone! Jacob runs by his defender and catches it for the touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Great throw, Zach!
As the players walk to the sidelines, Jacob runs over to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Where were you on that one?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It wasn't my fault! It was that guy's fault over there!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Bull! Every defensive lapse is your fault! That's what it means to be the leader! Phil wouldn't make a sorry excuse like that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not Phil!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No kidding! Phil was `actually` tough. He wasn't just some punk like you who picks on nerds. That's not tough... That's cowardly.
nodes.text_bbcode: No kidding! Phil was [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] tough. He wasn't just some punk like you who picks on nerds. That's not tough... That's cowardly.

nodes.text: Jacob glares at Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Come on, Jacob... Let's get some water.
Jacob starts to walk away but then turns back to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Coward!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr!
Spencer charges at Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know you don't know anything about sports...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good start...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I also know that people like you. I saw you get all those signatures for your dumb Science Club.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It didn't look like you threatened anyone... Or their families... Or their unborn children...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's... True... Are you going to punch me now? You've got that face again...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Relax about that, would you?! I'm not going to punch you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... Then what are you getting at?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sure you heard, but... I accidentally sprained Phil's ankle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So?! He's like the football team's superstar linebacker! And I have to take his place!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh wow. Remind me, is the linebacker the one with the stick?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Never mind. Forget it. Getting football advice from you is like asking a nerd how to kiss!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! I know how to kiss!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure. You couldn't find first base on a baseball field, and you couldn't find first base with a girl!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why don't you just get to the point?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Everyone on the football team hates me! But I don't know why... I can tackle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm guessing you've `got` talent, Spencer. You've been tackling people for years! I saw you tackle Alexei! It's almost like you've been training for football without really meaning to.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm guessing you've [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] talent, Spencer. You've been tackling people for years! I saw you tackle Alexei! It's almost like you've been training for football without really meaning to.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like in that karate movie! With the kid who wants to learn karate! He's like a kid who karates everyone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think it was called Kid of Karate!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You really are the worst at titles.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Never mind. Your problem isn't your talent. It's your attitude.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up! No, it isn't!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay! Maybe it is! But I don't like people! They tell you you're wrong all the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, I've dealt with people with team problems before...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The trick for you is going to be controlling your temper. Don't let anyone get under your skin.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just think about something soft and cute...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's dumb. What else?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Be positive. Instead of insulting someone the way you just did with me, say something nice!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't do nice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And last... Swallow your pride.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A lot of people don't like you. But football is a `team` game. That means you're going to have to help out someone you don't like.
nodes.text_bbcode: A lot of people don't like you. But football is a [color=#e23b3b][i]team[/i][/color] game. That means you're going to have to help out someone you don't like.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't help people.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then you're going to have a tough time...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is good advice. You're just too thick-headed to listen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why don't you go to one more practice? You might surprise yourself!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We got this, guys. Easy touchdown...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, they've practically given up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Time out!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What? You can't call a time out in a practice!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just did! Huddle up, defense!
The defensive team gathers around Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... I keep messing up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: I'm Chris! I'm the cornerback!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cornerback? How many backs are there in football?

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: Let's just let them score, so we can move on to the next drill...
The rest of the defense nods...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you serious?! How can you guys think that?! Do you really want to let Zach and Jacob win?!

nodes.speaker: Defender
nodes.text: Are you going to punch us now?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa... Ben's always afraid I'm going to punch him too... What advice did he give me? Be more positive?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Now we're going to work on special teams...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Special teams?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Spencer! You're going to be the lead blocker in the wedge...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Like a potato wedge?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Just keep people from tackling Jacob, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What? `He's` protecting me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#e23b3b][i]He's[/i][/color] protecting me?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We hate each other!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I don't care. You're on the same team, you'd better look out for each other!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You hear that? You'd better look out for me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale said this would happen! Man, that guy is smart!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I'm going to prove myself, this is my chance!
Howard kicks the ball into the air... It sails over Spencer's head, and Jacob catches it! Spencer lumbers forward ahead of him!
A defender comes at Jacob from the right!
As Sam beats Spencer, Howard climbs to the top of a nearby locker and jumps off, his elbow aimed for Spencer's stomach!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `ATOMIC ELBOW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]ATOMIC ELBOW![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer flings Jessica off him and gets back on his feet...
Just in time to see Jacob hurtling toward him!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But what I want to know from you is...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: If I spend the time and energy over the next week, turning you into a master middle linebacker...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Do you have the heart not to quit? Will you give your everything to crush those Wilson High meatheads?!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Son, it pains me to see that without our star player, we have to bring someone like you into our ranks...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Wilson High's defenders are three times the size of Howard here!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: They'll eat us alive if we're not ready!
Coach turns his attention to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That was one of the worst displays of teamwork I've ever seen in my entire coaching career!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: If we block that against Wilson High, we'll be pulverized into cracker crumbs!
Across the way, Coach steps onto the field!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whoa! Coach! You're back!

nodes.text: That looked a lot like a Phil tackle!
For the next few plays, Spencer breaks through the offensive line, tackling Zach!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Good work out there, Spencer...
As practice continues, the offense adjusts, double-teaming Spencer, and advancing down the field...
Spencer gets low and barrels into both of them!
Spencer manages to block one of them! The other dives at Jacob, but Jacob is too fast for him!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I think it's pretty clear that Spencer here has all the capacity to be an amazing player.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I agree.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Welcome to the team!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Congratulations, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You earned it, bro.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That was some fine `amateur` blocking!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was some fine [color=#e23b3b][i]amateur[/i][/color] blocking!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But it's not going to be enough against Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It's good to see that you've been accepted by the players and assistant coaches...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But your acceptance doesn't mean anything if you can't tackle when it really counts! When the pressure is on and everyone in the school is depending on `you!`
